states.changed: First state: the world's counted AI chips as one land surveyed every quarter since 2022, parcelled by owner at exact shares, growing 334-fold at true scale with the five hyperscalers in red, the smuggled chips offshore within their modelled range, the unfinished quarter falling back inside the coast of 2025, and a hum of the stock's power.

The cluster list stands on the land as stakes at true area in their owners' parcels (433 at the end of 2025, the 175 unnamed clusters in China dashed), the public clusters stand in a dashed column off the coast that the owner table does not have, and the five's share now reads 70.9 % of the land drawn beside 68.6 % of every counted chip.

The public column now stands empty by default, a dash and not a zero, with the cluster list's public clusters only as crossed markers when asked for; an inset draws the same division at one size so the five's spread from 56.6 % to 70.9 % can be watched from the first survey; the smuggled shoal is named as the one place a state's law shows; one red figure stands on the map; presented.
